a11y_responsive.evidence: Looked at mobile_full.png and tablet_full.png first: 375px stacks hero copy then a single 16rem mosaic pane, spec table, plant, lab, then footer; hamburger + 56px sticky Call/Quote bar; no clipping or lost primary content (later sections still show tanks/lab). Tablet keeps the hamburger and stacked sections; uses list splits to two columns at 768px. Audit iter-2: blockers [], contrast 0 fails of 76 desktop / 73 mobile, focus 0 invisible of 25, h1=1, heading_skips=0, img_missing_alt=0, unnamed_controls=0, lang/title/desc/viewport present, landmarks main+nav+footer, horizontal_overflow false at 375, tap_targets_under_24=0 (previous 5 footer-nav <24px blocker is fixed via .foot nav a min-height/min-width 44px), tap_targets_under_44=1. Skip, labeled Main/Footer navs, mosaic role=img with aria-label and child alt="", visible labels+for on contact form, consent labeled. Remaining: footer focus ring #013ea8 on #011637 ~2:1; .mark is the leftover <44px target; footer p tel/mailto/privacy still inline 12.5px.
strengths: Skip link, lang=en-IN, one h1, no heading skips, labeled Main/Footer navs, 0 missing alt and 0 unnamed controls.
Real reflow at 375px (not scaled desktop): mosaic collapses to one pane, 56px sticky Call/Quote bar, no horizontal scroll.
Previous 5 mobile footer-nav targets under 24px are gone; 0 contrast failures on 73-76 samples; 25/25 focus outlines present on light surfaces.

issues.problem: Global :focus-visible outline is 3px #013ea8. On footer #011637 that pair is about 2:1, below WCAG 1.4.11 3:1, so keyboard focus on footer nav and contact links is effectively invisible. .contact already overrides to white; footer does not.
Audit still reports 1 target under 44px on both desktop and mobile. `.mark` is inline, no min-height; 1.5rem wordmark plus .78125rem small stacks to about 38-42px.
issues.fix: Set `a.mark { display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; }`.

issues.where: footer .foot p a (tel, mailto, Privacy policy)
issues.problem:
These stay `display:inline` at footer 12.5px with `
` between them, so hit height is ~21px. Audit skips inline-in-p links, so they never counted in the old 24px blocker, but they are still hard to tap and sit on adjacent lines with no 24px gap.
issues.fix: Make the column `display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:flex-start; gap:4px` and `footer .foot p a { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; min-height:44px; }`.

issues.problem: Checkbox is 24×24px. That meets WCAG 2.5.8 AA and the label is correctly associated, but it misses the 44px rubric target; the tick box itself is a small hit next to a long line of text.
issues.fix: Set `.consent input { width:44px; height:44px; flex:none; }` (keep the existing `label for="consent"`).

issues.problem: Form has visible labels and a required consent checkbox, but `novalidate` plus JS only writes a polite `role="status"` message. Failed fields never get aria-invalid, aria-describedby, or focus.
issues.fix: On validation fail: set `aria-invalid="true"` and `aria-describedby` to the status id on empty required controls, use `role="alert"` on `.status.err`, and `focus()` the first invalid field.
